title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
taper: From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen

ai_review.summary: Excellent tape (curated as the best available) featuring the first live Ripple and Truckin', with a vibrant crowd and solid acoustic‑electric flow.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this recording, calling it the premier curated version on the Archive and praising the historic first live performances of Ripple and Truckin'. The show is described as joyful with an enthusiastic audience, and while no technical flaws are noted, the tape’s sound quality is implied to be top‑notch.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews highlight both a stellar performance (first live Ripple and Truckin') and a high‑quality, well‑curated recording, supporting a near‑top rating despite the small sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewed as the best curated version on the Archive; no complaints about clarity or mix, implying a clear and balanced capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set followed by an electric set (with a suggested NRSP fragment in between), delivering a cohesive and energetic concert experience.
